title: Undercover
caption: Undercover (V)
game_text: Deploy on your spy at a site. Spy is now Undercover. During your control phase, may ▲ one Sabotage. At same and related sites, opponent’s {lightsaber} weapon destiny draws are -1 (-2 if targeting this character). {alter}
lore: Alliance Intelligence expends considerable resources to infiltrate the Imperial military bureaucracy, but the ISB’s security sweeps make these shadowy operations dangerous.
